newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait Real Estate Bank bonds issued.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait Real Estate Bank bonds issued.

text.p: Kuwait Real Estate Bank on Sunday raised 20 million dinars ($66 million) through the issue of five-year bearer bonds with a fixed annual interest of 7-3/4 percent.
"The issue was well received by the financial community and there was good demand," a banker involved in the issue told Reuters.

Another Kuwait Real Estate bond issue worth 20 million dinars with a fixed annual interest of 6-1/8 percent matured on Sunday. "The principal and the interest was paid in full on maturity," added the banker.
A 15 million dinar Kuwait Real Estate bond matures on December 25, 1998.

Kuwait National Bank (NBK) is the manager and underwriter of the new issue which was open to individuals and institutions in Kuwait and abroad. An NBK official said that although there was some interest from foreign financial institutions, the issue was taken up domestically.
The new issue was activated on Sunday. It will pay the annual interest on May 25 of every year starting 1998.
